books.short: Hear your Heavenly Father speak in His own words from Scripture, and learn to live as His beloved child instead of an orphan in heart.
books.long_html:
WHO AM I? AND DOES ANYONE WANT ME?

From the moment we are born, we begin asking that question. Until it is answered, we move through life restless and searching. It pressures us to strive, hide, and perform. The world is filled with grown adults still asking: Do I matter? Does anyone love the real me? Is it all up to me?

There is only one voice in the universe that can answer. And He has been speaking all along.


THE WAY TO THE FATHER

Jesus said, "No one can come to the Father except through Me." For centuries the church has heard "way to heaven." He said "way to the Father." The destination was never merely forgiveness or heaven. The destination has always been the Father Himself. Millions have believed in the way but missed the destination. They are spiritually emancipated yet experientially enslaved: sons and daughters on paper, but orphans in heart. They can serve a Master. They cannot rest in a Father.


IN YOUR FATHER'S VOICE

Father's Heart - Beloved Identity is a short, concise collection of the Father's words, in the Father's voice, revealing the Father's heart. Nothing has been put in God's mouth. His Word is complete. These passages have simply been gathered and arranged so you can hear Him speak directly to you. Each section follows one pattern: your Father speaks to you from His Word, and you respond with My Confession, declarations meant to be spoken out loud, because faith comes by hearing.


INSIDE YOU WILL FIND

Part One: The Invitation. A fatherless world, the wound every human carries (the fear of abandonment), and a fresh look at the Fall through the Father's eyes rather than the accuser's. Not anger, but mercy. Not condemning, but covering.

The world gives that wound many names: anxiety, codependency, rejection, trust issues, control. But the Father sees something deeper. He does not see a disorder to be managed. He sees a lie to be replaced and a child to be brought home.

Part Two: The Father Speaks. Eighteen short sections, including Who Do You Say That I Am?, I Am Your Father, My Heart for You, My Son, My Spirit, What Was Lost, What I Am Giving You, What I Am Restoring, What I Am Calling You To, The Enemy, My Family, Marriage & Family, Where This Ends, and My Answer.

Part Three: Believe & Receive. A statement of faith that makes the Father's heart central, daily affirmations of faith and identity, and guidance for living in the Father's heart.


HEAR THE DIFFERENCE

This book is a forerunner to the Father's Heart Bible (FHB), a forthcoming translation that restores the emphasis Scripture already places on God as Father. Where the FHB rendering reveals something a standard translation does not, the New Living Translation and the FHB appear side by side so you can hear the difference for yourself.


FROM INTIMACY TO INHERITANCE

The historic confessions told us what we are saved from, but not fully to whom we are saved. Standing in the legacy of the creeds, this book declares who God is as Father and who you are as His beloved child. Intimacy with the Father results in identity as His beloved. Identity results in inheritance, not wages earned, but the full rights of sons and daughters.

Believe it and receive it. Daily. Now hear your Father's whisper.

books.author_bio: Karen Inge Hailstones is a wife, a mother of three and a first-time author from KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. She grew up on a sugar cane farm near Wartburg and went on to earn a Master's degree in Dietetics, including five months as an exchange student at Uppsala University in Sweden. Married to Eric for nine years, Karen is a full-time mom who also helps in his business, Car Solutions, a pre-owned car dealership in Hilton. She loves sewing, gardening and opening her home to others. Who Am I? grew from her desire to share the love of our Father in its simplest form, so even the littlest ones can hear who He says they are.
books.page_title: Who Am I? Read-Aloud Devotional by Karen Inge Hailstones
books.short: Kids books that build self esteem and courage start here: 21 watercolor 'I am' affirmations from our Father's heart for parents to read aloud with children ages 0-5, each with a Bible verse and a prayer.
books.long_html:
WHO AM I? SEEING MYSELF THROUGH MY HEAVENLY FATHER'S EYES

Long before a child can read a single word, they can know whose they are, and that is where real self esteem and courage begin. Who Am I? is a devotional book for parents to read aloud over and with their babies, toddlers, preschoolers and children who are just learning to read. It is a repeat affirmation book: twenty-one short 'I am' declarations of who a child is in our Father's eyes, made to be read again and again until your little one knows them by heart.


HOW EACH PAGE WORKS

Every affirmation follows the same simple, gentle pattern, so even the youngest listener learns what comes next:

• The affirmation – a clear 'I am' statement, such as I am wonderfully made, I am loved or I am never alone.
• The verse – a passage from the Father's Heart Bible that the affirmation rests on.
• The explanation – a few short sentences in words a young child can take in.
• The prayer – a brief prayer of thanks to our Father for parent and child to pray together.


TWENTY-ONE TRUTHS TO SPEAK OVER YOUR CHILD

I am wonderfully made. I am a child of our heavenly Father. I am loved. I belong to Jesus. I am chosen. I am never alone. I am brave and strong. I am Father's treasure. I am forgiven. I am a new creation. I have a family. I am protected. I am gifted. I have a purpose. I am healed. I am free. I am more than a conqueror. I am the light of the world. I am safe and calm. I am blessed. I am victorious.

The verses are drawn from across Scripture, including Psalm 139, Jeremiah 31, John 10, Ephesians 1, Joshua 1, Isaiah 53, Romans 8 and Matthew 5. The book closes with a page that gathers all twenty-one affirmations together under one question, So who am I?, and one joyful answer: That is who I am!


WHY READ IT AGAIN AND AGAIN

Little ones learn by hearing the same words many times. This book is designed for exactly that kind of repetition. Each affirmation is short enough for a toddler to remember, and each prayer is simple enough for a preschooler to echo back. Over weeks and months of reading, the twenty-one truths move from the page into your child's heart, so that when they feel scared, lonely or unsure, they already have our Father's words ready: I am loved. I am protected. I am safe and calm.


MADE FOR LAPS, BEDTIMES AND QUIET MOMENTS

Soft watercolor illustrations and a square 8.5 x 8.5 format make this an easy book to hold with a little one at bedtime, at naptime or in any quiet moment of the day. Read one affirmation at a time or the whole book in one sitting. Because the pattern never changes, children soon begin to say the words along with you, and the closing page becomes a declaration they can speak on their own.


A GIFT FOR NEW AND GROWING FAMILIES

Who Am I? is written by Karen Inge Hailstones, a mom in South Africa, for parents who want to speak our Father's truth over their children from the very first years of life. It is a natural choice for new parents, grandparents, godparents and anyone who wants a child to grow up knowing they are loved, chosen and never alone.


Open it tonight, read it again tomorrow, and let your child discover, page by page, who they are in our Father's eyes.
